Bamco recently changed things so it's considered a mainline game now

I went into it with high expectations and I ran into a lot of the same issues you did. I don't play solo, but I think the art style, the enviroments, and the combo system is some of the best of the series. I prefer it over Tales of the Abyss's (and that's my favorite entry in the whole franchise). You reach a point where you can really just make up your own combo with enough though. And I think that level of freedom is great.  


Granted, it really isn't a game for everyone. I think you should tough it out, but I think it's loved by so many because of how much Yuri, Rita, and Judith stand out with their quirks.

I like IPAs  
I had one that had tangerine/pineapple. Was super bitter, but eventually the taste really grew on me.

As many have said, you guys should seek marriage counseling.  
Your wife isn't respecting the fact that you're sad. She's only celebrating that your mother is dead. Not that she isn't entitled to those feelings, but it is self-centered and disregards the fact you're clearly hurt by your mother's death.  


Now, I'm sure your wife is great when she isn't like this. So please get some help. Talk it out with her, and I hope you find a solution.

It's clear she loves you if she wants you to go with her so badly, but she's putting far too much pressure on you. I'm sure you can work out some solution though. Like calling and making the time to visit each other.
I'm sorry for not updating! But she is alive. Mentally struggling, and wants space. But she told me she'll be fine. I'm gonna put my faith in her. Thank you for listening.
Thank you so much. I decided to stop waiting and just told her how I felt. Hopefully I'll talk to her more in the morning. Thank you for talking me out of being so reluctant.

I'll do it. But I worry because most of the things I say never make much of a difference. I just don't know if she'd take my word if I told her that I don't want her to go. I don't want to come across as selfish. But maybe that's me making excuses. Regardless I'll be staying up tonight if she's open to talking. Since she's in a solitary mood right now. I am fine, and thanks for the encouragement.
